prananasvarupanirupananantarananunanaprananan saparikaran asninparicete katyate kin karanan tatanukrahakan hetukarpanitan saptapranananu-krahakatvatucyata ityarta tatanantaran kuta vetarupa sapta pratana-nityuktatvat pratanoktyanantaranevanukrahakokteravasaratityarta yatva prananantaranukrahakananuktva vetanukrahakokti kuta ityato vetarupa sapta pratananityuktatvatiti ‘yatartyaneva nanatvan tanukyan cnanasaptayo’ iti yuktipatiyanuvyakyane ‘yatartyaneva prananyan tanukyan cnanasaptayo’ iti prahnatarke ca tatyatartyan cnane kevalapranane vetarupapranane ca nukya-nityasya tatparyan
